scope: Fail-closed identity and invalidation map for replacing the frozen H67 ep35 evidence population with the final c12_binary_motion_ttx checkpoint. This draft executes nothing and admits no performance, accuracy, power, PPA, or system claim.
evidence_reuse_without_resynthesis_if_to: C1 and C2 external ready/valid and fault protocols
C1 exact parent/subset/tie semantics and one-port scratch interface
C2 typed signed-source descriptor and shared Acc24 protocol
directed protocol attacks and data-independent SVA properties
logic-area and static-timing results for parameter-identical RTL
SRAM macro area and port timing for the same bound macro identities
mandatory_checkpoint_rebind_and_replay: checkpoint and config load audit with missing=0 and unexpected=0
quantized weight, bias, threshold, and neuron-constant export identities
ordered full-network execution trace and per-operator payload manifests
activation, source, product, destination, and parent-hit sparsity statistics
C1, C2, C3, attention, patch, FFN, Conv, and decoder cycle ledgers
SRAM and DRAM address-timed transaction traces
SAIF activity, PTPX dynamic power, energy per frame, and memory energy
decoder-complete and full-network system denominator/numerator tables
valid825 accuracy and every lossless or lossy Pareto point
conditional_resynthesis_triggers: layer shape, channel count, T, rank, descriptor width, accumulator width, or memory depth changes
final exported integer ranges invalidate an existing overflow or saturation proof
threshold or neuron coefficients are compiled into RTL or ROM and their bit pattern changes
new signed, ternary, or analog value classes are outside the directed verification domain
a checkpoint-dependent optimization changes control flow rather than only activity
minimum_final_rebind_order: select one of epochs 9/14/19/24/29 using a sealed validation protocol
seal checkpoint SHA256, config SHA256, load audit, and valid825 receipt
export and seal integer weights/biases/thresholds plus range proofs
regenerate ordered traces and operator payloads on the frozen multi-sequence cohort
replay component and decoder cycle simulators under unchanged resource contracts
rebuild Table-A/B/C without mixing H67 ep35 and final Motion rows
red_lines: checkpoint_epoch9.pth is a recovery/candidate identity, not the final paper checkpoint
H67 ep35 sparsity, cycle, traffic, energy, or system ratios may not be relabeled as final Motion
unchanged RTL PPA may be reused only after an explicit topology/precision/parameter identity audit
